title: Valved Graft PMCF Study
official: Valved Graft Post-Market Clinical Follow-up Study
summary: Multicenter, global, prospective, non-randomized, interventional, post-market trial. All subjects enrolled will receive an Abbott Valved Graft device.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* cardiac surgery including the implant of a VAVGJ or CAVGJ for native or prosthetic valve replacement

Exclusion Criteria:

* anticoagulation therapy intolerant
* active endocarditis
* anatomical or medical, surgical, psychological or social contraindications

sites.f: University Hospital - Univ. of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB)
Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania
